The closest match is [1], which is by Mykhailo Poliakov and Nadiya Shvai and specifically addresses metadata filtering in Multi-Meta-RAG. It replaces a prompted metadata extractor with a local, deterministic hidden-state probe for filtering a vector store by metadata. [1]

Other papers discuss metadata-enriched or metadata-driven RAG more broadly, but not this specific filtering setup: [3], [4], [6], [7], [9], and [10] focus on improving retrieval with metadata, chunking, or pipeline design, while [2] is a conceptual framework for corpus partitioning and metadata-based routing. [5] examines when metadata helps or hurts RAG performance, rather than proposing a metadata filter. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]
